service: taller-ch11
frameworkVersion: '3.40.0'

provider:
  name: aws
  runtime: nodejs22.x
  region: ${env:AWS_REGION}
  stage: ${env:TALLER_EQUIPO}
  iam:

  httpApi:

    cors: true

  environment:
    TABLA_HOTELES: { Ref: TablaHoteles }
    TABLA_RESERVAS: { Ref: TablaReservas }
    TABLA_HUESPEDES: { Ref: TablaHuespedes }
    TABLA_ASIGNACIONES: { Ref: TablaAsignaciones }


functions:
  salud:
    handler: src/salud/handler.handler
    events:
      - httpApi: { method: GET, path: /salud }
  crearReserva:
    handler: src/reservas/crear-listar/handler.crearHandler
    events:
      - httpApi: { method: POST, path: '/reservas' }
  listarReservas:
    handler: src/reservas/crear-listar/handler.listarHandler
    events:
      - httpApi: { method: GET, path: '/reservas' }
  eliminarReserva:
    handler: src/reservas/eliminar/handler.handler
    events:
      - httpApi: { method: DELETE, path: '/reservas/{reservaId}' }
  modificarNoches:
    handler: src/reservas/modificar-noches/handler.handler
    events:
      - httpApi: { method: PATCH, path: '/reservas/{reservaId}' }
  trasladarReserva:
    handler: src/reservas/trasladar/handler.handler
    events:
      - httpApi: { method: PATCH, path: '/reservas/{reservaId}/hotel' }
  consultarHotel:
    handler: src/hoteles/consultar/handler.handler
    events:
      - httpApi: { method: GET, path: '/hoteles/{hotelId}/reservas' }

resources:

    TablaHoteles:
      Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
      Properties:
        TableName: HOTELES_${env:TALLER_EQUIPO}

                KeyType: RANGE  # Sort key. Ordena por ID.
            Projection:
              ProjectionType: INCLUDE  # Claves + campos de abajo.
              NonKeyAttributes:        # Campos de RESERVAS copiados al índice.
                - NOMBRE
                - NOCHES

    TablaHuespedes:
      Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
      Properties:
        TableName: HUESPEDES_${env:TALLER_EQUIPO}
        # PK: HUESPED_ID. Datos: NOMBRE, APELLIDOS, EMAIL (en Entity).
        BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
        AttributeDefinitions:
          - { AttributeName: HUESPED_ID, AttributeType: N }
        KeySchema:
          - AttributeName: HUESPED_ID
            KeyType: HASH  # Partition key: identifica al huesped.

    TablaAsignaciones:
      Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
      Properties:
        TableName: ASIGNACIONES_${env:TALLER_EQUIPO}
        # PK compuesta: RESERVA_ID + HUESPED_ID. Dato no clave: ROL.
        BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
        AttributeDefinitions:
          - { AttributeName: RESERVA_ID, AttributeType: N }
          - { AttributeName: HUESPED_ID, AttributeType: N }
        KeySchema:
          - AttributeName: RESERVA_ID
            KeyType: HASH  # Partition key: agrupa las asignaciones de una reserva.
          - AttributeName: HUESPED_ID
            KeyType: RANGE # Sort key: distingue al huesped dentro de la reserva.
        GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
          - IndexName: PorHuesped
            KeySchema:
              - AttributeName: HUESPED_ID
                KeyType: HASH  # Agrupa las asignaciones del huesped.
              - AttributeName: RESERVA_ID
                KeyType: RANGE # Ordena sus reservas por ID.
            Projection:
              ProjectionType: INCLUDE
              NonKeyAttributes:
                - ROL # Copia ROL al índice; ambas claves ya se incluyen.

  Outputs:
    HuespedesTableName:
      Value: { Ref: TablaHuespedes }
    AsignacionesTableName:
      Value: { Ref: TablaAsignaciones }
